title: Italian Eggplant Fritters
description: Crispy Italian eggplant fritters, perfect as a side dish or appetizer. Adapted from traditional Italian cuisine.

ingredients.name: glazed
ingredients.notes: such as honey or maple syrup

instructions: 1. Cut the eggplant into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, eggs, parmesan, salt, and pepper.
3. Dip each eggplant round into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
4. Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Fry the eggplant fritters until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Drizzle the fritters with the glazed mixture and serve warm.
